cases.name: moment is dropped from the verdicts
caught_by: a moment is counted as its own verdict, not as open: moment: wanted 1, got None; untriaged: wanted 1, got 2; problems: wanted 0, got 1 ["a.md: unknown verdict 'moment'"]

a moment needs no `by`, where closed and deliberate do: moment: wanted 1, got None; problems: wanted 1, got 2 ["a.md: unknown verdict 'moment'", 'a.md: `It does not do the second thing.` is closed and names nothing that closed or decided it']

cases.name: the withdrawal pattern matches anywhere, not at the lead
cases.expect_survivor: equivalent: the pattern is anchored with ^ and re.MULTILINE is not set, so search can only match at position 0, which is what match does
